CHAPTER 4  
IMPLEMENTATION 
4.1 Introduction 
The following chapter will explore the practical implementation aspects of the 
eLearning application, designed to enhance student engagement and academic 
performance among GCSE students. Utilising the theoretical frameworks and 
novel qualities as defined in previous chapters, chapter 4 will delineate the 
details of the project’s architecture and design. While additionally covering the 
employed methodologies and design choices, used to meet the project’s robust 
set of requirements.  
4.2 Platform Selection 
The following sections will delve into the decision-making process of selection 
the mobile platform and backend services. 
4.2.1 Mobile Platform of Choice and Rational 
Given the points made Table 5 Non-Functional Requirements, a mobile 
application will be developed. This section will Rationalise the optimal 
development platform for a mobile application given the non-functional 
requirements specified in Table 5. 
Selection principles: 
• High reach – As per Table 5, this ensures the maximum number of users 
will have access to the application.
